summary: A Victorian painted-lady townhouse in `build.nbt` (26x40x30, front north), written as code: `build.mjs` for the form, `mcd roof` for the roofs, `detail.mjs` for the finish, `make.sh` to rebuild. Palette is light-blue concrete powder, cream quartz trim, cherry-pink and gold accents, a slate mansard and a verdigris turret cap. It has a round corner turret, a canted bay, a gabled entry porch with a sunburst, and a walled front garden. `mcd check` shows 0 floating and 0 unsupported blocks, and `mcd palette` shows no flags. The only orphans left are 6 roof-preset pieces. `tasks.json` has 10 tasks and `gaps.md` lists the toolkit gaps. Not yet fixed: the porch has no 'THE PAINTED LADY' sign, and the gate pillars hold tiny signs.
elements: Corner turret with conical cap: `cylinder()` tube over three storeys with 3-pane windows and quartz hoods; `tower-cap` roof via library `roof()` in a copper/prismarine mix with a lucarne; quartz finial post, lightning rod and a pink wall banner as pennant
Canted two-storey bay: 3-wide front with 1-wide splays, glass panes, classical surrounds, a flower window box (`planter` brush), small `gableRoof` gablet with pink gable and gold course
Mansard roof: `mcd roof --preset townhouse` (dark-slate mansard, dentil cornice, iron crest) with three pink-walled dormers and two brick chimneys
Gabled entry porch: `gableRoof` with pink gable end and a bamboo sunburst, pale-oak spindle posts, stair brackets, hanging lanterns, steps with wall cheeks, potted tulip and allium
Front door set: spruce door with glass sidelights and transom, classical `surround`, flanking `pilaster` brush columns, red carpet runner and hall wall behind the glass
Fish-scale shingle band: pink cherry stairs (low step out) plus planks under the eave on every face
Trim: stone belt course with slab lip between storeys, quartz corner boards, cream hoods and sills, open cherry-trapdoor shutters on flank windows
Front garden: stone-brick dwarf wall with iron-bars railing, gate pillars with lanterns, stone-brick path, flower beds (tulips, allium, cornflower), azalea hedge
Signs: spruce wall signs on the gate pillars ('No. 7 / 1887' and 'THE PAINTED / LADY / TOWNHOUSE')
Back stoop with small gabled hood, hanging lantern and pale-oak posts; windows with shutters on the back and both flanks
polish: The roof is a big, dark, heavy mass; its preset dormers read as plain boxes and the slate hides the third storey
Turret hood and sill rows look like stacked shelves; the curved tube would need a proper curved-surround brush
Flank and back walls are repetitive (the same shuttered window ladder); they need a bay, a chimney breast or a balcony for variety
Sign text on the gate pillars is too small to read at street distance; a larger plaque or blade sign on the porch is still missing
Interior behind the glass is empty apart from a hall back wall; windows read as dark or brown holes at some angles
Light blue concrete powder is more saturated cyan than a true pastel painted-lady blue; the pink (shutters, band, dormers) is a bit much
Porch lacks a proper balcony or railing over its roof, and the garden has no gate leaf, so the gap between the pillars reads as an opening
6 minor orphan pieces remain, all roof-preset parts (crest slabs and cone dormer pieces)
